# SIPANEL

> SIPANEL is an industrial building envelope engineering company specializing in sandwich panel systems, standing seam & ZIP roofing, aluminium cladding, and glass & polycarbonate daylighting. The site is multilingual (Persian, English, Arabic, Russian); Persian is the primary source of truth.

Canonical host: https://www.sipanelco.ir
Localized URL prefixes: `/fa` (default), `/en`, `/ar`, `/ru`. Any English URL below has equivalent pages under the other locale prefixes.

## Engineering Systems

- [Systems overview](https://www.sipanelco.ir/en/systems): Index of SIPANEL building envelope systems.
- [Sandwich Panel Systems](https://www.sipanelco.ir/en/systems/sandwich-panel-systems): Insulated wall and roof sandwich panel solutions.
- [Standing Seam & ZIP Roofing](https://www.sipanelco.ir/en/systems/standing-seam-zip-tech-roofing): Concealed-fix metal roofing systems.
- [Aluminium Cladding](https://www.sipanelco.ir/en/systems/aluminium-cladding-covering): Aluminium facade and cladding covering systems.
- [Glass & Polycarbonate Daylighting](https://www.sipanelco.ir/en/systems/daylighting-transparent-roofing): Transparent and translucent daylighting roofing.
